summary.text: Jasjit "Jay" Gotra, an independent businessman and former solar-sales company CEO, lost the November 3, 2026 election for Governor of Rhode Island to Helena Foulkes.
It was his first campaign for office.

paragraphs.text: Gotra was born and raised in Mumbai, India, and immigrated to the United States as a teenager, American Bazaar reported.
He built a business career that included founding Alliance Security Inc., and he is the former CEO of Smart Green Solar, a solar sales company.
Gotra filed paperwork declaring his candidacy with the state elections board on May 8, 2026, as a Democrat.
He later qualified for the November ballot as an independent.
He said that if Rhode Island was not fiscally profitable by the end of his first four-year term, he would not run for reelection.
His campaign, "Grow Rhode Island Together," paired fiscal discipline with that pledge.
He received 0.5% of the vote to Helena Foulkes's 57.7%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
